label: For "Uplift Modelling for Campaigns": Target ads or offers only to users whose conversion probability rises because of the treatment, to maximise incremental conversions. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on non-randomised past targeting.
